motor.note: GWM Australia markets the Tank 300 as a turbo-petrol PHEV 4WD pairing the engine with an electric motor for a quoted combined system output of 300 kW and 750 Nm and a 3,000 kg towing rating. The electric motor's individual type, count, power and torque are not published in the available sources.

variant.source: GWM Australia (gwmanz.com) for the PHEV 4WD turbo-petrol/300 kW/750 Nm claim; Chinese config pages (official Tank SUV site, Sohu Auto, NetEase Auto, PCauto, Autohome) exist but their retrieved snippets contained only navigation/UI text, not spec values

notableFacts.text: The Tank 300 is specified with three Eaton differential lockers and a low-range gearbox, unusual hardware for a compact 5-door SUV; the Australian-market PHEV version is also rated to tow 3,000 kg. Separately, GWM UAE describes the Tank 300 HEV as offering a 'creeping mode' that automatically manages power and braking to hold a stable low speed off-road, a note that applies to the HEV rather than the PHEV trim.
